messages.subject: Possible Zentaril rash — fictional patient
messages.body: Hello PV team. I am Dr. Priya Nair (physician, India). A 67-year-old woman developed generalized urticaria after Zentaril 10 mg oral. Started 4 Jan, reaction day 3, recovered after stopping. Weight 72 kg, hypertension history. Fictional case only.
